title: Instruments
intro: This level covers shares, bonds, funds, ETFs and EU structured products as securities: their rights, cash flows, NAV and market price, booking and custody. It also covers returns, volatility, correlation, and duration as a derivative. The learner can describe and read the price of each instrument.
